pairedDefenderModelComparison.selectionRule: latest completed run per defender model in the newest case-hash cohort with at least two models; each selected run must contain exactly one defender model

method.pairing: same synthetic scenarioId and experiment arm across defender models; only evaluable recorded side-effect outcomes are included
method.difference: compared-model side-effect rate minus reference-model side-effect rate; positive means more attack effects for the compared model
method.interval: paired percentile bootstrap, 95%, 20000 resamples, deterministic seed derived from matched rows
method.significance: two-sided exact McNemar test with Holm adjustment across arms within each model comparison
method.interpretation: Exploratory matched comparison on the fixed synthetic case set; it describes these runs and does not establish a general model ranking.

fixtureEvidence.note: These are repository-owned synthetic fixture records. Arms A/B/C use the unprotected fixture or AgentGuard path; only D records TrustedExecutionGateway events. No external MCP server or wire protocol was exercised.
